title: Manufacturing Plant Manager
text:
The Plant Manager oversees the daily operations of the manufacturing facility. This role involves managing production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards, maintaining a safe work environment, and optimizing processes for efficiency and cost-effectiveness. The Plant Manager will lead a team of supervisors and operators to meet production goals while upholding the company’s standards for safety and quality.

Roles and Responsibilities:

· Lead cultural transformation initiatives that align behaviors, mindsets, and daily actions with the company's values in safety, quality, service, and continuous improvement

* Plan, organize, and oversee the manufacturing process to ensure production targets are met.
* Develop and manage the plant’s budget, including labor, materials, and overhead costs.
* Develop and execute strategies to enhance employee engagement, recognition, and retention.
* Foster a service-oriented mindset across the plant, ensuring all employees understand their role in meeting and exceeding internal and external customer expectations.
* Build a culture where continuous improvement is part of everyday problem-solving at all levels.
* Empower employees to identify, test, and implement improvement ideas.
* Regularly communicate the vision, progress, and achievement of the cultural transformation to inspire and motivate teams.
* Implement lean manufacturing practices to improve efficiency and reduce waste.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of supervisors, operators, and other plant personnel.
* Prepare reports on production performance, costs, and other key metrics for senior management.

Competencies:

* Strong leadership abilities with a proven track record of motivating and managing teams effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to interact with all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of quality control principles, methodologies, and industry-specific standards (e.g., ISO, Six Sigma).
* Proficiency in lean manufacturing techniques, continuous improvement processes, and waste reduction strategies.
* Strong understanding of workplace safety regulations, OSHA standards, and safety management practices.
* Accountable for execution of Safety, People, Quality, Delivery, and Cost-driving escalation to ensure customer service for internal and external customers.
* Execute all responsibilities according to lawful and ethical standards as established by company policies and procedures.

Experience and Education:

* Bachelor’s Degree: Preferably in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Management, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field or a minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a manufacturing environment in similar role
* **Experience in manufacturing plant management with focus on Manufacturing and Quality resource accountability min 5 yrs**
* Bilingual highly preferred
* Familiarity with manufacturing software systems and data analysis tools. Competence in using software for planning, scheduling, and reporting.

Pay: $140,000.00 - $155,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Manfacturing Leadership: 6 years (Required)

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
